Read-only native Windows DXGI+CIM sample captured through the Strixy WSL qualification environment on 2026-09-24. The fixed PowerShell collector completed in 5.38 seconds without WSL_INTEROP in its environment. LUID binds only the physical Radeon adapter; other virtual adapter counters were excluded. Capacity is DXGI dedicated graphics reservation (32 GiB), separate from OS-visible RAM (~95.8 GiB). SharedCapacityBytes is a borrowing limit and must never be added to either total. No temperatures or power values were measured.
